description: Screen an Ethereum address or `.eth` ENS name for on-chain reputation risk. Costs 1 credit. Returns a signed reputation score (-100 to +100), a risk band, a confidence level, a sanctioned flag, the top evidence factors, a screeningId, and a link to the full report. The enhanced review is generated in the background. Fetch it with get_screening_narrative(screeningId). Use the score, band, and sanctioned flag to gate pre-trade or payout flows.

address.description: Ethereum address (0x...) or `.eth` ENS name (e.g. vitalik.eth) to screen. ENS names resolve to their current mainnet address and must resolve or the call errors. Addresses are case-insensitive and need not be checksummed.

name: screen_address

band.description: Reputation band, e.g. Low Risk, Reputable

evidence.description: Up to 10 signals behind the verdict, most severe first

code.description: Stable code for this signal, e.g. OUTBOUND_DUST_SPRAY

factor.description: Category of the signal, e.g. Behaviour Patterns

reportUrl.description: Link to the full report on the Probity dashboard

sanctioned.description: True if the address is a direct OFAC match

score.description: Signed reputation score from -100 to +100. Lower is worse.

title: Screen address
